Finally got it!  I focused on having AA use as many different songs as possible on DV--probably overkill and others will have to narrow it down.  I believe he used one song on her every time he used a power; he definitely used at least one song on her a round. He never did damage to her, but he did grant her a power, two plays, a couple of draws, and 1 point of healing.  However, I had DV skip her play phase every turn, so the only cards she played were:

  • Inventive Preparation plays Twist the Ether.
  • Slamara puts Prophetic Vision into play.
  • Slamara puts Wrest the Mind into play.
  • Alacritous Subdominant plays Prophetic Vision.

Jansa vi Dero was in play at the end, but we've seen that doesn't matter.  Lots of Endlings were in play, and only a couple had died.  She never dealt damage to herself or anything else with Wrest the Mind (it went on a Sonic Mine, which hit her first).

So I think we're on the right track.  It's probably win a game in the Enclave of the Endlings with (Dark?) Visionary and (normal?) Argent Adept on the team.  Visionary must be incapacitated.  Argent Adept must have used (some subset of songs) on Visionary.

Just need to figure out what subset that is.  Unfortunately, that will probably require some trial and error.  I'll go through the logs and see what I can spot.

Edit: I'll just use this space to track what I find.

Unlock log 1: Used Alacritous Subdominant and Inventive Preparation to grant multiple plays, Counterpoint Bulwark for a draw, Rhapsody of Vigor several times, Syncopated Onslaught to boost her damage once, and dealt damage to her with both Onslaught and Scherzo.

Unlock log 2: Well, here goes the theory: Used only Alacratous Subdominant to give her two plays, damaged her three times with two plays of Scherzo, and dealt her quite a bit of damage from two plays of Syncopated Onslaught (boosted).  That does make all three types of song, but it's only 2 uses each of 3 songs.

Unlock log 3: One Inspiring Supertonic to give her a power, four Inventive Preparations to grant plays, one Counterpoint Bulwark for a draw, then killed her with Scherzo.  7 songs, at least one of each type.

Unlock log 4: Even less.  One Inspiring Supertonic, one Inventive Preparation, and three Scherzos.  I think that's enough successful logs, so now I'm going to check the fails to see if any of them meet: Win a game in the Enclave of the Endlings with Dark Visionary and normal Argent Adept on the team.  Visionary must be incapacitated.  Argent Adept must have used at least 5 songs on Visionary, including at least one Melody, Harmony, and Rhythm.

Edit 2: Nope, that's not it.  Again, the first fail log in this thread meets those criteria.  Back to the drawing board.

Edit 3: Since I had her play only 3 different cards, I went through the logs looking for them.  Twist the Ether appears in every success but also appears in Tskami_ek's failure.  No other Visionary card appears in every success.
